14 | Merging | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

20 | Displacement IV | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | E

50 | Hiding True | caster | C | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Causes caster to appear blurred to attackers, subtracting 10 from all attacks.
@@ 2
A single object is made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.) until 24 hrs
pass, the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling,
etc.), or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).
@@ 3
The caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow. Thus, they are
almost invisible in dark areas. In many situations this could be handled with
a Stalking/Hiding bonus between +25 and +75.
@@ 4
Any sounds originating within a 1' radius of the caster’s body are completely
muffled. This results in a special bonus of +25 to Stalking.
@@ 5
As Unseen I, except everything within 1' of the target is invisible as long as
it is within the 1' radius and none of the Unseen termination conditions
occur. See Section 15.5 (p. 96).
@@ 6
As Invisibility I, except the caster can vary the radius up to 1'.
@@ 7
Creates a 1000 square foot screen on which the caster can place any static
scene. The scene seems 3- dimensional and normal.
@@ 8
Caster appears to be offset from where he really is, all attacks have no
effect 10% of the time (no normal RRs). Each time a foe misses him, the chance
of “no effect” for that foe goes down by 5%.
@@ 9
As Invisibility I, except caster is also undetectable by smell and sound.
@@ 10
Creates a duplicate of the caster. If the caster concentrates, it will move as
he wills; otherwise, it does exactly as he does. With a round of
concentration, the caster can merge the shadow mystic with himself and then
split apart again.
@@ 11
As Invisibility I, except radius is 10'.
@@ 12
As Displacement I, except base chance of missing is 20%.
@@ 13
Caster is flattened until he has only two dimensions. Thus, he can slide
through cracks (and can’t be seen from the side).
@@ 14
Caster can merge into any inanimate, solid material. While merged, the caster
cannot move or perceive. When the caster emerges, he can emerge from any side
or face of the material. The caster caster cannot move “through” any material
greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet.
@@ 15
Caster has no “presence” (for the purposes of presence detection spells).
@@ 16
As Displacement I, except base chance of missing is 30%.
@@ 17
Caster can pass through 1' per level of any inorganic material at the rate of
2' per minute.
@@ 19
As Merging, except caster may turn within the material and perceive the world
outside the material if within 6'' of the surface.
@@ 20
As Displacement I, except base chance of missing is 40%.
@@ 25
Caster and objects on his person cannot be detected by any “Detect ...”
spells.
@@ 30
As Displacement I, except base chance of missing is 50%.
@@ 50
Caster can “Merge” into a material, use “Unpresence,” use “Nondetect” and
observe surrounding activity; all with this one spell.
